text: Do not use these standard containers: `std::stack`, `std::vector`, `std::deque`, `std::list`.

Match the brackets with a stack you implement yourself: a plain array (a fixed `char` array, or memory you allocate) and the index of its top. Push each opening bracket and pop it when its closing bracket comes. Recursion, a library container, or any method without such a stack does not satisfy this constraint.
